name: oci-cli-workbench
description: AIDP migration, project delivery and agent development with an AIDP-first edit/test/Playground loop, explicit endpoint publication, local OCI tooling and reproducible evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Migrate data and develop AIDP agents through editor tests and Playground before publishing.
interface.longDescription: AIDP Migration Workbench helps Codex migrate or create AI Data Platform projects from mixed source evidence in `.source`, including SQL, notebooks, documentation, exports, and legacy artifacts from platforms such as Azure data platforms, Databricks, Cloudera, SQL Server, Oracle, or document-only requirements. It standardizes project-local Azure context in `.az`, can bootstrap Azure CLI readiness and inventory Azure data-platform resources before handing findings into source intake, then uses `.oci` and the local OCI CLI to plan, validate, bootstrap, deploy, and operate AIDP workspaces with reusable skills and guarded workflows. The plugin includes offline execution-attempt summaries, correlated Volume and driver diagnostics, Spark path-consistency guidance, checkpoint-preserving streaming recovery, and reproducible migration validation. AIDP platform retirement remains outside automated wrapper cleanup. It separates execution repeatability, exact result correctness and operational evidence, with offline output decoding and Spark/Volume diagnostic procedures.
defaultPrompt: Develop an AIDP agent using editor and tool tests, iterate in Playground, and publish its endpoint only when I request it.
Inspect `.source` and propose an AIDP migration plan.
Use `.source` and `.oci` to create a new AIDP project from source artifacts or requirements documents.
Bootstrap the local OCI CLI environment and validate the target AIDP workspace.
Bootstrap `.az` Azure CLI context and inventory Azure data-platform resources before shaping an AIDP migration manifest.
Validate Azure Databricks to OCI/AIDP row-count parity and prepare sanitized evidence for a reproducible report.
Diagnose irregular AIDP Spark executions using official documentation, logs and immutable experiment evidence.
Assess repeated full runs with separate execution, correctness and operational verdicts.
